question: What martial and cosmic-cognitive attributes define the honored deity?
premises: The deity bears the sword of time.
The deity has a mind formed of constellations.
Obeisance is offered to these aspects.
inference: The deity is honored as wielding time's weapon and possessing a cosmic, stellar awareness.
uncertainties: kaṭaṅkaṭa interpreted as sword or weapon
plain_english: Obeisance to the bearer of the sword of time; obeisance to the one whose mind is the form of the constellations.
